title: Clinical response of pigment epithelial detachment associated with neovascular age-related macular degeneration in switching treatment from Ranibizumab to Aflibercept

groups.description: Eyes with active nAMD and a fovea-involving PED of at least 100 µm at the switch, switched from ranibizumab to aflibercept for inadequate clinical response to ranibizumab

exclusions.reason: Before the switch (switch-study rule: the reference is the switch visit).

exclusions.what: Table 2 column C6, Last follow-up visit
Table 4 BCVA change at 1 year by PED morphology and by retinal fluid
exclusions.reason: Changes only, without the baseline acuity of each subgroup (inclusion 3).

notes: Retrospective non-comparative case series: 50 of 218 eyes switched from ranibizumab to aflibercept met the inclusion criteria (ranibizumab first, fovea-involving PED, PED height of at least 100 µm at the switch); these are conditions at the switch, not post-baseline selection.
Eyes were switched for inadequate clinical response to ranibizumab (response to an earlier treatment before the reported period).
Aflibercept in the first year after the switch: monthly for 3 months, then every 2 months (fixed_interval); individualised PRN or treat-and-extend from year two.
The 4-month visit follows the 3 monthly aflibercept loading injections; Table 2 states its time since the switch.
No minimum follow-up criterion; the duration of aflibercept treatment differs between eyes (Tab1!R5C2) and per-visit n is not reported, so later means may include fewer eyes (ordinary attrition).
PED height and width (Table 2 rows R3-R4) and injection numbers (Table 1) are not extracted.

series.notes: mean (SD) (Table 2 caption); ETDRS letters (Table 2 footnote; Methods: ETDRS letter score); reference is the switch visit and months are counted from the switch; per-visit n not reported
